novel_features.name: Launch
novel_features.description: Create a workspace and first session, send a brief, and return the Conductor deep link.
novel_features.rationale: Combines workspace launch, message delivery, and identifiers into one bounded operator action.
novel_features.example: conductor-pp-cli launch --repository-url https://github.com/example/acme --branch main --harness codex --model gpt-5.4 --effort high --brief-file issue.md --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent needs a new isolated Conductor workspace and task in one call.

novel_features.name: Monitor
novel_features.description: Poll a session until real completion while streaming only new transcript events.
novel_features.rationale: Correct completion needs status history plus transcript changes to avoid Conductor's queued false-idle race.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this instead of treating one idle response as proof that a queued task finished.

novel_features.name: Steer
novel_features.description: Send follow-up guidance to an existing Conductor session with a clear delivery receipt.
novel_features.rationale: Turns the message primitive into an agent-safe intervention command.
novel_features.example: conductor-pp-cli steer sess_123 --message 'Run the focused tests before changing the schema' --dry-run --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to correct or refine active work without creating another session.

novel_features.name: Run
novel_features.description: Launch, monitor, and collect the final transcript and deep link with explicit timeout rules.
novel_features.rationale: Joins asynchronous lifecycle operations into a single bounded receipt without merging or deploying.
novel_features.example: conductor-pp-cli run --repository-url https://github.com/example/acme --branch main --harness codex --model gpt-5.4 --effort high --brief-file issue.md --timeout 30m --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when the caller needs a complete Conductor task receipt, not just a launched workspace.

novel_features.name: Plan and implement
novel_features.description: Keep a planner or reviewer session separate from the implementation session in one workspace.
novel_features.rationale: Uses Conductor's multi-session workspace model to preserve role separation and context boundaries.
novel_features.example: conductor-pp-cli plan-implement --repository-url https://github.com/example/acme --branch main --planner-agent claude --implementer-agent codex --brief-file issue.md --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when implementation should start from an explicit plan without mixing planner and coder context.

novel_features.name: Daily report
novel_features.description: Return recent Conductor session rows and mechanical activity totals from transcript search.
novel_features.rationale: The read-only transcript SQL endpoint can assemble cross-workspace activity without the desktop app.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this for a compact, deterministic activity feed that another agent can analyze.

narrative.headline: Every Conductor Cloud API primitive, plus bounded session orchestration that handles asynchronous lifecycle races.
narrative.value_prop: Use `launch`, `monitor`, `steer`, and `run` to control coding-agent work without relying on the desktop app. The CLI treats status changes, transcript cursors, cancellation, and timeouts as one lifecycle instead of unrelated API calls.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set `CONDUCTOR_API_KEY` to a Conductor Cloud API key. The CLI sends it only as a bearer token to `api.conductor.build` and never prints it.

quickstart.comment: Check configuration and command wiring without credentials or network mutations.
Confirm the key resolves to the expected Conductor user and organization.
Find a project ID before launching a project-backed workspace.

quickstart.command: conductor-pp-cli launch --repository-url https://github.com/example/acme --branch main --harness codex --model gpt-5.4 --effort high --brief 'Run the focused test suite' --dry-run --json
quickstart.comment: Preview a bounded launch payload before creating anything.

troubleshoots.fix: Set a valid `CONDUCTOR_API_KEY` and rerun `conductor-pp-cli doctor`.

troubleshoots.symptom: A session reports idle immediately after a message is queued.
troubleshoots.fix: Use `monitor`; it waits for working state or transcript movement before accepting a later idle state.

troubleshoots.symptom: Cancellation returns before work has stopped.
troubleshoots.fix: Use the confirmation mode and poll until session status returns to idle.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for Conductor Cloud project, workspace, session, message, and transcript operations. Prefer the workflow commands when a task spans several API calls or depends on asynchronous status. Do not use it to read Linear issues; ENG-526 owns that integration.
anti_triggers: Merging pull requests or deploying code

recipes.title: Monitor an existing session
recipes.explanation: Streams incremental events and returns only after the task has demonstrably started and later completed.

recipes.title: Send steering guidance
recipes.command: conductor-pp-cli steer sess_123 --message 'Keep the change scoped to the parser' --agent
recipes.explanation: Adds guidance to the current session without creating a second workspace.

recipes.explanation: Returns mechanical session activity for downstream review or reporting.
